## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: sector breadth is constructive while leadership is narrowly concentrated in Technology (Top 5 = 5/5 tech), and several large caps show 1W/1M sign flips — mixed signals.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: SYK (1W: +13.91% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.87% | 1M: +2.72%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +5.01%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: WMT (1W: +4.47% | 1M: -0.33%) RECOVERY. Communication showing strength via CHTR (1W: +12.37% | 1M: -0.66%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging overall (1W: -1.48%): NVDA (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -2.54%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -20.21% | 1M: -37.84%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -22.23% | 1M: -20.38%) BELOW TREND. Energy and Utilities also weak: XOM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +15.21%) ABOVE TREND is exception; Utilities sector showing broad weakness.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: ACN (1W: +23.61% | 1M: +40.49%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +21.27% | 1M: +15.79%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +20.64% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +17.11% | 1M: +25.60%) ABOVE TREND, CRM (1W: +15.57% | 1M: +19.28%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: ETN (1W: -11.07% | 1M: -11.36%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -17.51%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -11.99% | 1M: -24.10%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -13.83% | 1M: -17.55%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -14.35% | 1M: -12.05%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Technology and Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: ACN (1W: +23.61% | 1M: +40.49%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +21.27% | 1M: +15.79%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +20.64% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR divergence: several large caps (META, CHTR, LLY, UNH) have opposite 1W vs 1M signs — tactical volatility, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed and bifurcated: ACN/NOW/ADBE/INTU/CRM ABOVE TREND (1W strong) while semiconductors and big cap hardware are BELOW TREND — NVDA (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -2.54%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -20.21% | 1M: -37.84%) BELOW TREND; sector breadth negative.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are steady-to-constructive: V (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +7.93%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +10.72%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -1.01% | 1M: +5.12%) CORRECTION — breadth supportive but watch idiosyncratic pullbacks.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare showing leadership and defensive ballast: SYK (1W: +13.91% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.87% | 1M: +2.72%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +5.01%) ABOVE TREND; sector breadth constructive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to Healthcare and high-quality Financials (V, MA, PFE) and monitor the narrow tech leadership (ACN/ADBE/CRM) for follow-through; reduce exposure to lagging semiconductors and industrial names showing confirmed deterioration (INTC, AMD, CAT). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given positive breadth but narrow top-end concentration.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: ACN (1W: +23.61% | 1M: +40.49%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +20.64% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +5.01%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -20.21% | 1M: -37.84%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -22.23% | 1M: -20.38%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -2.54%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (Breadth supportive; 17 stocks positive on 1W). BEARISH: Technology (sector 1W: -1.48%, many key names mixed) and Utilities (weak 1W/1M).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -2.54%) BELOW TREND — watch the 1W low for breakdown confirmation; AAPL (1W: +3.77% | 1M: +20.04%) ABOVE TREND — monitor 1M support for trend continuation; JPM (1W: -1.01% | 1M: +5.12%) CORRECTION — watch for re-test of 1M breakout level.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LRCX (+85): news says Q4 beat; price diverging — LRCX (1W: -20.97% | 1M: -38.59%) BELOW TREND, bullish sentiment but price is not confirming. PFE (+80): EU vaccine approval confirms price — PFE (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +5.01%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. MSFT (+60): Q4 beat and price supportive — MSFT (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +5.96%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming. RCL (+80): outlook raise confirmed — RCL (1W: +13.20% | 1M: +0.67%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
QCOM (-60): earnings miss and downward price action align — QCOM (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -17.51%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. INTC (-60): negative headlines and price align — INTC (1W: -20.21% | 1M: -37.84%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. AMD (-45): macro/AI unwind and price weakness align — AMD (1W: -22.23% | 1M: -20.38%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. WMT (-45): negative retail headlines but price is RECOVERY — WMT (1W: +4.47% | 1M: -0.33%) RECOVERY, sentiment diverging.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. ACN (1W: +23.61% | 1M: +40.49%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +20.64% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +5.01%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow tech leadership and multiple large-cap 1W/1M sign divergences (e.g., LRCX sentiment-price split, CHTR/META/LLY flips) — watch for confirmation before reallocating core exposures.
